breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous instruction to use a constant peak moment M = PL over the full span. Instead, it specifies that M(x) should be set up properly and integrated as M(x)^2/(2EI) from 0 to L, then differentiated with respect to P — matching the ground truth approach where the bending moment varies along the span as expected for a cantilever under an end load.
